title: Extreme Low-State Quantized Transformer for Electricity-Load Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.28784v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Aggressive low-state weight quantization can substantially reduce neural-network representational flexibility, making predictive performance difficult to preserve when only a few discrete weight states are available. We investigate this regime for Transformer-based electricity-load forecasting using 3-, 5-, 7-, and 16-state weight quantization across feed-forward-only and attention-plus-feed-forward quantization. Two tasks predict either the next hour or the next 24 hours from the preceding 48 hours across two co-primary electricity-consumption datasets. Direct post-training quantization (PTQ) increased mean normalized root-mean-square error (NRMSE) relative to full precision by 6.25 and 7.04 percentage points in Datasets A and B, whereas quantization-aware fine-tuning (QAT-FT) recovered approximately 90.2% and 94.5% of these penalties. translated_title: 面向电力负荷预测的极端低状态量化Transformer
translated_abstract: 激进的低状态权重量化会大幅削弱神经网络的表示灵活性，使得在仅有少量离散权重状态可用时难以保持预测性能。我们针对基于Transformer的电力负荷预测任务研究了这一极端情形，在两种量化方案（仅前馈层量化、注意力加前馈层量化）下分别采用3状态、5状态、7状态和16状态权重量化。实验包含两项任务：基于前48小时数据预测未来1小时或未来24小时，并在两个共同主要指标的电力消费数据集上进行评估。结果显示，直接训练后量化（PTQ）相对于全精度模型，在数据集A和数据集B中使平均归一化均方根误差（NRMSE）分别增加6.25和7.04个百分点，而量化感知微调（QAT-FT）分别恢复了约90.2%和94.5%的性能损失。从随机初始化开始的量化感知训练（Scratch-QAT）也取得了具有竞争力的低状态量化性能。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文研究了极端低状态（3至16状态）权重量化对Transformer电力负荷预测模型的影响，发现量化感知微调（QAT-FT）可恢复约90%以上的量化精度损失，显著优于直接训练后量化（PTQ）。
en_tdlr: Quantization-aware fine-tuning (QAT-FT) recovers over 90% of the accuracy loss caused by extreme low-state weight quantization (3- to 16-state) in Transformer-based electricity-load forecasting, substantially outperforming direct post-training quantization (PTQ).
